meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 把旧的 NanoClaw 与 Claude 记忆迁移进统一的 groups/<文件夹>/memory/ 记忆树和 instructions.prepend.md 常驻指令。它先暂存文件、隔离符号链接、整理索引，最后逐项核对并等你批准。
howto.when: 更新提示 shared-memory 破坏性变更后，或群组里仍留有 .seed.md、旧 CLAUDE.md、Claude 自动记忆等文件时运行；你说 “migrate memory” 等词也会触发。

say.text: 帮我迁移记忆，把旧的 .seed.md 和 CLAUDE.md 并进来
say.note: 先列出受影响群组，等你批准再动文件

say.text: 检查一下哪些群组还有遗留记忆没迁移
say.note: 会显示受影响群组、冲突与符号链接情况

say.text: 切换之后 agent 好像什么都忘了，帮我看看记忆
say.note: 启动迁移流程并核对迁移结果

howto.what_en: Migrates legacy NanoClaw and Claude memory into the shared groups/<folder>/memory/ tree and provider-neutral instructions.prepend.md. It stages, quarantines symlinks, organizes indexes, then verifies and awaits operator approval.
howto.when_en: Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md, Claude auto-memory, etc. Also triggers on "migrate memory".

say_en.text: Migrate my memory and merge the old .seed.md and CLAUDE.md
say_en.note: Lists affected groups and waits for your approval first

say_en.text: Check which groups still have unmigrated legacy memory
say_en.note: Shows affected groups, collisions, and symlinks

say_en.text: The agent forgot everything after the switch
say_en.note: Starts the migration workflow and verifies results
